data.name: Dhansukh
data.gender_notes: Dhansukh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dhansukh is a Sanskrit name that combines the words dhan, meaning wealth or prosperity, and sukh, meaning happiness. This name is believed to bring blessings of wealth, prosperity, and happiness in life. The name Dhansukh carries the meaning “Prosperity and Happiness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhansukh usually hope their child will grow to embody prosperity and happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the pursuit of spiritual wealth and inner happiness.
data.etymology: Dhansukh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Prosperity and Happiness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhansukh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
